title: Repairs and maintenance of Minicoy North Lighthouse, in the UT of Lakshadweep
summary: Civil repairs and maintenance of Minicoy (North) Lighthouse Station at Minicoy, UT of Lakshadweep, under the Kochi Directorate.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

scope.item: Repairs and maintenance of Minicoy North Lighthouse

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; originals of EMD (or MSME/UDYAM/NSIC certificate) with technical documents to reach office by post or in person. Bid Securing Declaration also listed among required documents.

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Government/PSU/autonomous body; OR, for Lakshadweep contractors, work experience with any Government department during last 7 years in island works

Similar works completed in last 7 years: three of >=40%, or two of >=50%, or one of >=80% of estimated cost (similar works: construction or repair/maintenance of building/road/CC pathway/lighthouse tower or other civil works)
Annual turnover of last three years certified by Chartered Accountant
Declaration that bid is unconditional; affidavit on Rs 100 stamp paper that bidder is not blacklisted
Undertaking listing relatives serving as Gazetted/Account officers in MoPSW/DGLL
Copy of EPF/labour registration certificate; Tender Acceptance Letter; Bid Securing Declaration
notes: Only Section I (NIT, pages numbered 2-8) is published; BOQ is in the CPPP tender document. Bid submission 02.09.2026 10:00 to 22.09.2026 15:00; bid query last date 07.09.2026 15:00; last date of EMD 21.09.2026 15:00; technical bid opening 23.09.2026 15:00.
